company.name: ArcticFlow Technologies Oy
company.description: ArcticFlow Technologies Oy is a Finnish technology company based in Helsinki that provides software development, cloud solutions, data engineering, and AI automation services for small and medium-sized businesses.

target_audience: small and medium-sized businesses that want to modernize their software, cloud infrastructure, data processes, or business workflows
key_messages: Helps businesses modernize existing digital systems
Connects different applications and data sources
Makes better use of business data
Focuses on practical and maintainable technology solutions that can evolve as customer needs change
